name: research
description: Orchestrate scientific research, publish curated Flywheel lineage, and materialize reproducible experiments across verified GPU rigs.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific orchestration and reproducible GPU research
interface.longDescription: Scaffold fresh Research 2.0 projects, coordinate manual or autonomous scientific and engineering loops, synthesize literature, challenge assumptions, audit decisive evidence, publish curated Flywheel lineage, integrate reference implementations through protected deviation approval, provision exact uv environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch and monitor GPU waves, reconcile run state, maintain a narrative journal, and create result visualizations.
defaultPrompt: Run a scientific research loop with explicit scientific and engineering modes.
Scaffold a fresh Research 2.0 project with program, journal, Flywheel, environment, and rig contracts.
Publish a completed experiment or scientific insight to the canonical Flywheel graph.
Compile an approved research step into a reproducible experiment and monitor its GPU wave through completion.
